relations.subject: Sándor Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: In 1799, he went to Nagyenyed (present-day Aiud) to join the boarding school Bethlen Kollégium... In 1815 he passed the public rigorosum in his studies at Bethlen Kollégium.

relations.subject: Sándor Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: Here he was influenced by the professor Samuel Hegedüs.

relations.subject: Sándor Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: continued university studies, taking an interest in history, a subject made popular by Professor Ádám Herepei.

relations.subject: Sándor Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: A scholarship allowed him to continue to Göttingen, where he began to learn English under Professor Fiorillo... Between 1816 and 1818 he studied Oriental languages.

relations.subject: Sándor Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: where he began to learn English under Professor Fiorillo.

relations.subject: Sándor Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: Csoma de Kőrős also came under the influence of Professor Johann Gottfried Eichhorn.

relations.subject: Sándor Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: he was immersed in an intense sixteen-month study of the Tibetan language and the Indo-Tibetan Buddhism at the core of its literature, with a local lama, Sangs-rgyas-phun-tshogs.

relations.subject: Sándor Csoma de Kőrös
relations.evidence: From 1837 to 1841, he worked as Librarian of the Asiatic Society.
